annotation.title_clean: 次世代医療機器評価指標の公表について
annotation.title_en: Publication of Evaluation Indicators for Next-Generation Medical Devices
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 厚生労働省医薬食品局審査管理課医療機器審査管理室 (MHLW Evaluation and Licensing Division, Medical Device Evaluation Office)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare notification (薬食機発0118第1号)
annotation.summary_en: Japanese MHLW notification (Jan 2010) publishing non-binding evaluation indicators for next-generation medical devices: fracture reduction assist devices and joint surgery assist devices (robotic, physician-approved automation), plus two cell sheet products. Sets safety, non-clinical and clinical-trial evaluation points for approval applications, referencing ISO/IEC machinery and robot safety standards.
key_provisions_or_claims: Evaluation indicators are non-binding and intended to speed product development and approval review.
Fracture reduction and joint surgery robotic assist devices must demonstrate mechanical safety, emergency stop, overload prevention and positional accuracy.
Devices that act automatically under physician approval likely require clinical trials.
Non-clinical evaluation may reference JIS/ISO/IEC standards such as ISO 10218-1, ISO 12100, IEC 60601-1.
Applicants are encouraged to use PMDA consultation early.
